title: Technology Consulting Associate (Digital Assets & Payments)
location: New York, NY / San Francisco, CA / Hybrid
description:
Role Overview

Join PwC's Technology Consulting practice as a Digital Assets & Payments Associate. In this role, you will work alongside senior technology architects and industry consultants to help global financial institutions, payment networks, and enterprise clients design, evaluate, and implement blockchain infrastructure, stablecoin payment rails, and tokenized asset platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support client engagement teams in conducting technical evaluations of public and permissioned blockchain networks (Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Avalanche, Hyperledger).
  • Assist in documenting architecture requirements, smart contract transaction flows, and API integration specifications for digital asset custody and payment platforms.
  • Perform quantitative analysis on market trends, stablecoin settlement volumes, tokenized real-world asset (RWA) flows, and decentralized finance (DeFi) primitives.
  • Participate in proof-of-concept testing, decentralized application (dApp) user experience reviews, and smart contract workflow validation.
  • Prepare high-impact client presentations, industry whitepapers, and benchmarking studies on central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), MiCA regulations, and SEC compliance frameworks.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Economics, or related quantitative discipline.
  • Demonstrated interest or hands-on experience in Web3 technology, EVM smart contracts, digital asset custody, or fintech payment infrastructure.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with programming languages (Solidity, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go) or blockchain indexing tools (Etherscan, Dune Analytics, Chainalysis) is a strong plus.
  • Excellent teamwork, written communication, and presentation skills.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive entry-level salary ($95,000 - $125,000 USD base depending on location) plus annual performance bonus and certification sponsorship.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage starting on day one.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with PwC matching contributions.
  • Generous paid time off (PTO), firm holidays, and annual firm-wide disconnect weeks.
  • Structured career mentorship, technical training programs, and support for professional certifications (CISA, AWS, Certified Blockchain Developer).

About PwC Digital Assets Consulting

PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is a global leader in professional services operating across 151 countries. PwC's Technology Consulting and Digital Assets practice provides strategic guidance and technical implementation to Fortune 500 banks, asset managers, and Web3 enterprises driving the future of digital finance, stablecoins, and tokenized markets.

title: Quant Trader
description:
About Kappa Lab:

Kappa Lab is a digital-assets market maker. We provide continuous, round-the-clock liquidity across 50+ centralised and decentralised exchanges, quoting a wide range of assets. Our proprietary technology and quantitative models let us price consistently and respond quickly across every venue we trade.

About the role:

As a Quantitative Trader you will join a hands-on trading team, taking ownership of live market-making strategies while researching and prototyping new ones. This is a role for someone who enjoys the challenge of achieving high performance and PnL plus the analytical side of markets and the engineering that makes trading work in practice.

What you will do:

  • Own live market-making strategies: tune quoting parameters, spreads, sizing and hedging, and diagnose and improve performance
  • Research, prototype and launch new quantitative strategies across venues and asset classes
  • Analyse execution quality in depth - fill quality, adverse selection, realised spreads, and trading costs
  • Work in our configuration-as-code platform, where strategy parameters are version-controlled, reviewed and deployed like software
  • Monitor live trading and manage risk through volatile market conditions
  • Work closely with engineering on the systems you trade through, and contribute code to them yourself

What we are looking for:

  • Strong quantitative reasoning and real comfort applying statistics to noisy, fast-moving data
  • Production-grade Python: code others can maintain, sensible use of version control, and the ability to debug a live system under pressure
  • Evidence you can turn large market datasets into a decision and clearly explain your reasoning
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrency markets, blockchain technology, and trading concepts
  • Sound judgement about risk: knowing when to size down, hedge or stop
  • A proactive mindset and ability to spot opportunities, move fast, and make things happen

Strongly valued:

  • Experience in market making, high-frequency trading, or systematic execution
  • Proficiency in Rust
  • Familiarity with DeFi and on-chain execution

Location and Working Style:

We have offices in London (UK) and Dubai (UAE) and operate on a hybrid basis.

This role combines classical data analysis with technical knowledge of tracking systems like GA4 and Amplitude, and requires strong experience in attribution logic across advertising platforms like Google Ads and Meta Ads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create dashboards and automated reporting for business and product teams.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to translate data into clear, actionable recommendations.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Solid hands-on experience with GA4, Amplitude, and modern tracking systems "under the hood".
  • Expertise in traffic attribution modeling (first click, last click, linear, etc.) and their business impact.
  • Understanding of pixel-based vs server-side tracking, and ability to architect scalable tracking flows.
  • Familiarity with enriching event data using external sources (UTMs, CRM, etc.)
  • Strong background in classical analytics and behavioral data analysis.
  • Experience working with advertising platforms such as Google Ads and Meta Ads from a data/attribution perspective.
  • Proficiency in SQL

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills to present insights.

About the Role

The Product Owner will be responsible for all Tangem Pay (TP) related products, including payment flows, internal tooling, financial rails, and monitoring capabilities.

The role focuses on product execution, reliability, and operational scalability, rather than commercial ownership.

Key Responsibilities

Product Leadership & Scope

  • Own the product vision, roadmap, and success metrics across all Tangem Pay products, not limited to on/off-ramp or local payments.
  • Ensure alignment between payment experiences, internal operations tooling, financial infrastructure, and monitoring platforms.
  • Translate company-level strategy into executable product initiatives across TP squads.

Execution & Squad Collaboration

  • Work across four core squads:
    1. Operations / Admin Panel Squad - internal tools for ops, support, and dispute handling.
    2. Payment Product Squad - user-facing payment flows and experiences.
    3. Financial Rails Squad - integrations with external payment schemes and providers.
    4. Monitoring Platform Squad - transaction monitoring, alerts, and operational visibility.
  • Manage the full product lifecycle: discovery → specification → delivery → launch → iteration.
  • Maintain clear documentation, user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint planning.

Payment Infrastructure & Financial Rails

  • Drive integrations with local and global payment schemes (ACH, SEPA / SEPA Instant, PIX, UPI, SPEI, etc.) via API partners or direct connections.

  • Ensure reliability and consistency of payment processing across regions.

Admin Panel & Operations Enablement

  • Own the admin panel and internal tooling used by operations, compliance, and support teams.
  • Ensure scalable workflows for:
    • Transaction reviews
    • Disputes and exceptions
    • Settlements and reconciliation
    • Customer support escalation
  • Balance operational efficiency with compliance and risk requirements.

Compliance, Risk & Monitoring

  • Partner with compliance teams to enable reusable and consistent KYC/KYB flows across TP products.
  • Collaborate with risk and monitoring squads to support:
    • Fraud and AML monitoring
    • Alerting and case management
    • Audit-ready data and logs
  • Ensure smooth partner audits and regulatory interactions.

Cross-Product & Platform Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Wallet, Infrastructure, and Growth teams to ensure unified UX and interoperability.
  • Align frontend and backend experiences across all TP-related products.

Requirements

Experience

  • Hands-on experience with payment rails and financial infrastructure.
  • Experience working with multiple squads in parallel.
  • Strong background in API-driven, compliance-heavy systems.

Skills

  • Deep understanding of payment systems, settlement cycles, and integration patterns.
  • Ability to translate complex technical and regulatory constraints into clear product requirements.
  • Strong communication skills across engineering, compliance, operations, and leadership.
  • Data-driven approach to defining and measuring product success.

Mindset & Leadership

  • Strong ownership mentality focused on delivery and reliability.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
  • Global mindset with experience working across regions and time zones.

Success Metrics

1. Product Delivery & Coverage

  • # of Tangem Pay payment schemes and platform components launched (e.g., ACH, SEPA Instant, PIX, UPI, SPEI, internal admin and monitoring tools) within planned timelines.
  • Speed to launch new geographies, partners, and platform capabilities (time from partner or scope approval → production go-live).
  • API and platform integration quality, measured by depth of supported features and reduction of engineering rework.

2. User Adoption & Platform Usage

  • Monthly active users of Tangem Pay payment features across regions.
  • Volume and value of transactions executed via Tangem Pay payment rails.
  • Conversion rates from onboarding to first successful transaction.
  • Cross-product activation (e.g., % of Tangem Pay users adopting multiple payment features; % of wallet users using Tangem Pay payment flows).

3. Operational Excellence

  • Transaction success rate (STP - Straight Through Processing).
  • Payment and platform failure rates and root-cause reduction over time (e.g., validation errors, compliance blocks, partner outages).
  • Average processing time versus scheme and internal platform benchmarks (e.g., SEPA Instant < 10 seconds).
  • Reduction of customer support and operations tickets related to Tangem Pay products.

4. Compliance & Risk Performance

  • Reuse rate of unified KYC/KYB across Tangem Pay products (minimizing repeated onboarding).
  • False-positive reduction in fraud/AML monitoring due to improved data quality and workflows.
  • Regulatory incident rate (zero critical compliance breaches; smooth audits with partners).

Why Join Us?

You will build one of the most foundational layers of Tangem's "Web3 bank" vision - the infrastructure that enables users to move value instantly and globally, regardless of geography or asset type. This role offers the opportunity to build a world-class payments capability from the ground up, shaping a product that will serve millions of users across continents.

description:

Project-Based Role with Potential to Become Permanent

About Tangem

Tangem is a Swiss self-custody technology company founded in 2017. We develop secure, easy-to-use NFC hardware wallets and have sold more than 6 million cards across 200+ countries, with a global team of 300+ people.

We see a potential opportunity for Tangem in the professional wealth and institutional segment, including family offices, HNWs, wealth managers, RIAs, corporate treasuries, and other financial institutions.

Our goal is not to become a regulated custodian, but to explore whether Tangem can serve as a secure self-custody and access-control solution, independently or alongside existing custody infrastructure.

The Role

We are looking for a senior US financial-services professional to lead a focused market research and strategy project.

We do not want to start with a predefined product or business model. The first objective is to understand how professional clients currently manage digital assets, what problems they face, where existing solutions fall short, and whether there is a meaningful commercial opportunity for Tangem.

Based on this research, the person will define who we should target, what we should build, how we should go to market, and how Tangem can monetize the opportunity.

1. Market Research & Customer Discovery

  • Interview family offices, HNWs, RIAs, wealth managers, corporate treasuries, custodians, and other relevant players
  • Understand current digital-asset custody, security, governance, recovery, and reporting processes
  • Map existing solutions and competitors
  • Identify unmet needs, purchasing behavior, and willingness to adopt self-custody or hybrid models
  • Prioritize the most attractive customer segments, use cases, potential partners, and pilot customers

2. Product & Business Strategy

Based on the findings:

  • Define priority customer segments and use cases
  • Develop Tangem's value proposition and positioning
  • Identify required product capabilities and integrations
  • Recommend an MVP / pilot
  • Define regulatory and operational considerations
  • Build an initial go-to-market strategy

Potential requirements could include multi-user approvals, permissions, transaction controls, audit trails, recovery, reporting, and integrations - but these should be validated through research rather than assumed upfront.

3. Monetization & P&L

  • Identify and validate potential revenue models
  • Define pricing and packaging
  • Assess customer willingness to pay
  • Estimate market and revenue potential
  • Define required product, sales, operational, and support investments
  • Build an initial P&L, including revenue, margins, costs, and break-even scenarios
  • Define commercial KPIs and investment required to launch and scale

Key Deliverables

The project should result in:

  1. Market and customer research with prioritized segments and use cases
  2. Recommended product / MVP and value proposition
  3. Go-to-market and partnership strategy
  4. Monetization and pricing model
  5. Potential pilot customer and partner pipeline
  6. Financial model and P&L
  7. Final go / no-go recommendation and launch roadmap

Ideal Background

We are looking for someone with senior experience in private wealth, family offices, RIAs, institutional digital assets, custody, corporate treasury, private banking, or WealthTech / FinTech.

The ideal candidate should have a strong US industry network, experience in customer discovery and new business development, and the ability to translate market insights into product strategy, commercial model, and P&L.

We are building capability for Tangem customers to trade US equities inside the mobile app (iOS/Android), with an external tech vendor as our partner. The US entity, its licensed officers, and the local regulatory work sit with outsourced specialists and external advisors. Everything those people need in order to do their jobs comes from headquarters - and that is your job. You are not the compliance function and you are not expected to be a securities expert. You are the person at HQ who makes sure the advisors, external tech vendor, and the internal teams have the information they need, and that requests are tracked, followed up and escalated where necessary.

Responsibilities:

  • Assemble and maintain the HQ-side inputs our external advisors need for the broker-dealer application: business and product descriptions, funding and money-flow narratives, technology and vendor schedules, organisational and reporting structure, and whatever else they ask for. You chase the underlying facts inside Tangem AG and turn them into what the advisors actually need.
  • Run the document request list: advisors and counsel will send us long lists with dates on them. You own the tracker, the owners, and the follow-ups, and you flag slippage before it becomes a delay.
  • Support the clearing broker relationship: consolidate our open questions, track their answers, keep a current view of what has been agreed and what is still open across clearing, API coverage, market data, KYC allocation, and commercial terms.
  • Hold external advisors to account as suppliers: read their drafts, catch places where they have misdescribed our product or our funding flow, and get corrections made rather than accepting the first version.
  • Produce revenue and cost estimates for the equities business, and keep them current as the commercial terms with the clearing broker and our vendors firm up.
  • Run competitor and market research on US retail brokerage and crypto-adjacent equities offerings; turn it into short memos that lead with a conclusion.
  • Keep documentation current - process maps, flow diagrams, and internal briefing material that design, engineering, and the US entity team can all work from.
  • Brief marketing and content so external communication describes the product accurately. In a regulated business the cost of a loose claim is higher than usual.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years as a business analyst, project or programme coordinator, consultant, or in an operations role.
  • Background in trading, brokerage, asset management, or financial services more broadly. We would strongly prefer someone who already understands how a brokerage business makes money and where its operational risks sit, rather than someone learning that on the job while coordinating a licence application.
  • Evidence of having assembled material for a regulatory filing, licence application, audit, or major vendor due-diligence process. Any jurisdiction - this is the closest analogue to the work.
  • Comfortable managing external advisors and law firms as suppliers: scoping them, holding dates, and pushing back on a draft that is wrong.
  • Organised under pressure across many parallel threads, with a working style that closes loops without being chased. Much of this role is knowing what is outstanding, from whom, and by when.
  • Precise written English. Specs, memos, and trackers that are short, structured, and unambiguous.
  • Effective across time zones and across a headquarters/subsidiary split, where the people who need information and the people who hold it are rarely in the same room.

Nice to have:

  • Able to read a technical document or an API description well enough to describe a system accurately in writing, and to talk to developers without needing a translator.
  • Securities regulation or fintech licensing exposure; experience supporting a market-entry or new-entity project; SQL or Python for quick data pulls; Figma and MIRO; crypto literacy and self-custody familiarity (relevant later, when tokenised equities enter scope).

닥터나우 프로덕트 팀은,

365일 24시간, 내가 원할 때 언제든 진료를 받을 수 있는 비대면 진료 서비스부터, 내 증상에 대한 다양한 고민을 묻고 해결할 수 있는 실시간 의료 상담까지. 고객이 아플 때 겪는 다양한 문제를 해결하는 서비스를 만들어요. 닥터나우는 모바일 앱 / 웹을 통한 유저향 서비스 뿐만 아니라, 병원과 약국의 진료 및 조제를 도와주는 의사/약사 서비스(B2H/B2P)도 운영하며 의료 전반의 영역에서 혁신을 만들고 있어요.

Product Designer는 이 모든 경험의 중심에서 고객의 문제를 직관적인 흐름과 설득력 있는 UI/UX로 풀어내고, 팀이 올바른 문제를 해결하고 있는지 끊임없이 질문하며 제품의 완성도를 높이는 역할을 수행합니다.
의료 영역에서 생기는 문제를 고객의 목소리를 통해 파악하고, 항상 고객 관점에서 생각하며 다양한 가설을 빠르게 검증해 나가는 분들과 함께하고자 해요. 새로운 시도에 가슴 뛸 준비가 되었다면, 지금 지원해 주세요!

ㅣ 함께 하면 이런 일을 해요

  • 닥터나우 서비스에 대한 깊은 이해도를 바탕으로 프로덕트를 설계하고, UX/UI 디자인을 통해 고객에게 가치를 전달하는 핵심 과정에 깊이 관여하며 최고의 고객 경험을 만들어요.
  • 고객들이 의료 생활 과정에서 겪는 다양한 문제를 발굴하고, 리서치-데이터-가설을 기반으로 문제를 구조화하여 디자인 솔루션으로 풀어내요.
  • PO/개발자/마케팅/CX 등 다양한 직군과의 협업 경험을 바탕으로, 명확한 근거와 논리로 설명하고 합의점을 도출해요.
  • 와이어프레임, 사용자 흐름, 프로토타입, UI 시안 등을 통해 아이디어를 빠르게 검증하고 성공적으로 제품을 출시해요.
  • 출시 이후에도 지표와 사용자 반응을 통해 문제를 재정의하고, 지속적인 개선 사이클을 주도적으로 실행하며 문제를 해결해요.

ㅣ 이런 분을 찾고 있어요

  • 사용자 문제를 관찰하고 Why 중심으로 사고하며, 논리적으로 문제를 정의하고 디자인으로 해결해 본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 사용자 흐름, 정보 구조, 인터랙션에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 완성도 높은 UI/UX를 설계하고, 실험 가설 및 A/B 테스트 설계에 참여해 보신 분
  • 고객 중심으로 사고하며, 정량적-정성적 데이터를 수집하고 해석해 디자인 의사결정에 반영하는 것이 익숙하신 분
  • 디자인 툴(Figma)을 활용해 완결성 있는 디자인 결과물을 만들 수 있는 분
  • 주도적이고 능동적으로 업무를 진행하고, 디자인 결과물에 대한 피드백을 주고 받는 유연한 태도를 가지신 분
  • 복잡한 문제에 대한 도전 정신이 투철하고, 새로운 비즈니스를 탐구하며 더 나은 방식의 도전을 즐기는 분
  • 3년 이상의 모바일 앱/웹 서비스 UX/UI 디자인 경험, 또는 그에 준하는 문제 해결 경험과 포트폴리오를 보유하신 분

ㅣ 이런 경험은 더욱 좋아요

  • 모바일 앱 / 웹 서비스를 기획하고 개발하여, 프로덕트로 비즈니스 성장을 견인하는 과정을 경험해본 분
  • 수요자와 공급자를 연결하는 플랫폼 비즈니스를 경험해 본 분
  • 복잡한 요구사항 속에서 비즈니스 임팩트와 리소스를 고려하여 디자인의 우선순위를 정할 수 있으신 분
  • 주니어 프로덕트 디자이너들의 성장을 서포트하며 디자인 조직의 일하는 방식을 개선해 본 경험이 있는 분
  • 디자인을 결과물이 아닌 '의사결정 과정'으로 인식하고, 팀의 사고 수준을 한 단계 끌어올리는 데 기여하고 싶은 분

ㅣ 포트폴리오는 이렇게 작성해주세요

  • 사용자 중심의 문제 해결 과정이 잘 드러날 수 있도록 작성해주세요.
  • 프로젝트별 역할과 기여도를 꼭 작성해주세요.
  • 정량적/정성적으로 어떤 성과를 만들었는지 알려주시면 더욱 좋아요.
  • 결과물을 잘 확인할 수 있도록 과한 투시의 목업 이미지는 피해주세요.

ㅣ 근무 조건 및 환경

  • 근무형태 : 정규직
  • 근무시간 : 주 5일(월~금), 10:00~19:00 (자율 근무제)

서류전형 ▸ 1차면접(실무, 라이브 디자인 테스트 포함) ▸ 2차면접 ▸ 최종합격

  1. 1차 면접에는 라이브 디자인 테스트가 진행됩니다.
  2. Figma를 통해 진행하며, 면접 중 실시간으로 간단한 화면을 설계하며 진행됩니다.
  3. 본 면접은 과제 제출 면접이 아니며, 결과물 완성도보다는 문제 접근 방식과 의사결정 과정을 보기 위한 자리입니다.
  4. 노트북은 당사에서 준비한 노트북으로 진행 예정

title: Korea Lead
description:
Title: Korea Lead
Location: Seoul, South Korea (Remote-friendly)
Type: Full-time

About Berachain

Berachain is a high-performance EVM-identical Layer 1 blockchain built on the novel Beaconkit framework, leveraging its unique Proof-of-Liquidity (PoL) consensus to accelerate applications and reward users. PoL routes Berachain's block rewards to the users of applications building in the ecosystem; investing the chain's native incentives into liquidity, activity, and other unique growth drivers on the network.

Berachain has raised over $100M from leading digital asset investors including Brevan Howard, Framework Ventures, Polychain Capital, Hack VC, Tribe Capital, Samsung Next, Laser Digital by Nomura, and many others.

Berachain's mainnet was launched in Feb 2025. As of June 2025, it stands as a top 10 L1 by TVL, and one of the only L1 ecosystems with a means of returning value to its tokenholders through Proof of Liquidity. The native ecosystem consists of dozens of teams across DeFi, DePIN, RWAFi, consumer crypto, gaming, AI and more, with corporate partners including some of the world's largest brands in sports, entertainment, and payments.

Berachain has built up a strong Korean community through our partnerships with local partners including A41, Despread, NodeInfra, 1XP and many others, supplemented by listings on leading exchanges like Upbit and Bithumb. We're looking to onboard someone to lead growth on the ground across community members, builders, institutions and more.

We're a fast-moving team of builders with deep conviction in crypto's potential to create open, permissionless financial systems. As we expand globally, we're looking for a Korea Ecosystem Lead to help us build a vibrant community of users, developers, and builders across the region.

Role Overview

As the Korea Ecosystem Lead, you'll be responsible for growing Berachain's presence in the Korean crypto market. You'll focus on cultivating and activating Korean retail users, trading communities, and developer ecosystems. This is a highly cross-functional role that involves ecosystem partnerships, community growth, developer relations, and cultural localization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ecosystem Growth: Build and execute go-to-market strategies to drive adoption of Berachain among Korean users and developers.

  • Community Engagement: Develop relationships with key influencers, trading communities, and local media to raise awareness and drive organic interest in Berachain.

  • Developer Relations: Work closely with Korean developer communities to onboard new builders, support dApp development, and organize hackathons, meetups, and educational initiatives.

  • Localization: Tailor Berachain's messaging, documentation, and content to fit the Korean market with cultural and linguistic nuance.

  • Partnerships: Identify and manage strategic partnerships with exchanges, wallets, media outlets, and DeFi protocols to grow Berachain's reach in Korea.

  • Advocacy: Serve as Berachain's voice and representative in the Korean ecosystem, including at conferences, community events, and in public forums.

Qualifications

  • 3-7 years of experience in crypto, preferably in a Layer 1, DeFi, or consumer-facing protocol.

  • Deep familiarity with the Korean crypto landscape, including trading communities, key influencers, and developer networks.

  • Proven ability to grow and manage communities, preferably with direct experience in Korea.

  • Strong communication skills in both Korean and English.

  • A self-starter mindset and ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience launching a token or supporting ecosystem incentives in Korea.

  • Track record of organizing successful events, hackathons, or campaigns in Korea.

  • Familiarity with Berachain's architecture and the Proof of Liquidity mechanism.

  • Relationships with more institutional market participants, in light of recent positive regulatory developments

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Marketing Lead

  • Business Development
  • Full-time
  • Remote friendly

Background:

Berachain is a high-performance EVM-identical Layer 1 blockchain turning liquidity into security, powered by Proof of Liquidity (PoL). PoL aligns incentives between liquidity and security across all stakeholders, driving unparalleled efficiency for users and builders while giving validators unprecedented control over network-wide economic incentives. Berachain uses our novel BeaconKit framework for building modular EVM blockchains, making Berachain the first blockchain beyond Ethereum to maintain full client diversity including EIP-4844, EIP-4788, and full SSZ Encoding, all while leveraging CometBFT to bring Single-Slot Finality to the table.

We're a young, world-class team of builders, engineers and executives hailing from tech, traditional finance and crypto itself. We've built and scaled companies, raised and deployed $Bs as fund managers, contributed to category-defining DApps and protocols, and built new primitives at every step of the way. We've packaged that experience and sprinkled in a healthy dose of fun to build Berachain.

Our core engineering and founding team is based in Toronto, with offices in Dubai and Bangalore, while our business development team is globally distributed. We have raised over $150M from leading digital asset investors including Brevan Howard Digital, Framework Ventures, Polychain Capital, and Hack VC, with support from other hedge funds, centralized exchange venture arms, and strategic angels.

Role Overview:

We are looking for self-starters and mission driven individuals to join us as we build the future of decentralized finance. The ideal candidate for this role takes initiative and ownership over their work, thrives in a fast-paced and highly collaborative in-person environment, and is capable of rapidly adapting to evolving needs as required.

The marketing lead would work closely with Smokey to develop and implement marketing strategies and guide the Berachain brand's evolution over time. The ideal candidate will work to increase market penetration across traditional finance and web2 ecosystems along with the existing crypto-native ecosystem across both the EVM and Cosmos ecosystems. The ideal candidate will work with the BD, Engineering and Design teams to produce content, own the marketing calendar, and develop go-to-market strategies for major product launches, updates, collaborations and more.

To date, Berachain hasn't spent any money on marketing. Our community of 30k+ on Twitter, ~45k+ on Discord and thousands of NFTs holders has been entirely organic. While many ecosystems have expended $Ms to build their communities, we've bootstrapped our chain and ended up with a negative customer acquisition cost by starting out as a heavily DeFi oriented NFT community. This organic growth is a trend that we'd love to continue for as long as possible, while staying true to the brand and community that we've developed and maximizing its accessibility to new users.

We have a STRONG preference for in-person role at our offices in Toronto, with exceptions made in extreme cases. The ideal candidate will demonstrate their ability to generate exposure opportunities for the Berachain ecosystem prior to joining the team, and has likely led growth or marketing initiatives at a major L1 or DeFi protocol in the past.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement data-driven marketing campaigns and initiatives in accordance with major business development and engineering milestones

  • Evangelize and onboard new users through the Berachain ecosystem across a variety of traditional and crypto-native mediums including Twitter Spaces, Discord, and more.

  • Organize in-person and virtual events around the Berachain community and ecosystem

  • Direct logistics around content creation for advertising campaigns and associated events

  • Drive and quantify user acquisition, retention and growth across multiple userbases and archetypes

  • Determine ROI and expected value of marketing initiatives and campaigns, and collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify highest value opportunities

  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the blockchain market and competition, and use this knowledge to inform marketing decision

  • Work cross-functionally with design, engineering, BD, and other teams to ensure successful product launches and ongoing product improvement.

  • Act as a user & protocol advocate, regularly engaging with users, protocols and other stakeholders to gain insights and feedback on the product.

Requirements

  • Track record of leading and scaling marketing initiatives and teams at leading L1s or blue chip DeFi protocols.

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, business development, sales, finance, preferably in the blockchain or financial technology industry, with a particular eye on DeFi and blockchain infrastructure technologies.

  • Strong understanding of blockchain technology and communities, particularly the EVM and Cosmos ecosystems.

  • Experience managing social accounts and media/advertising initiatives (Twitter, Discord, Instagram, Facebook, Google etc).

  • Experience running and managing lead generation, nurture campaigns, optimizing campaigns and realizing meaningful conversion metrics and ROI.

  • Thorough knowledge of the current DeFi, NFT-fi, GameFi, etc landscapes in the on-chain ecosystem.

  • Robust interpersonal communication and collaboration skills.

  • Experience building and scaling marketing teams to promote crypto-native and traditional brand awareness.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify and prioritize product features and requirements based on customer needs, market trends, and business goals.

  • An ideal candidate will have experience in both tradfi/web2 and crypto-native marketing initiatives.

  • Experience with HTML, CSS, and Wordpress for the buildout of simple webpages is an asset.

description:

Requirements:

  • 2+ years of prior hands-on experience in a technical role (Backend Development, Frontend Development, Tech Lead or DevOps Engineering) is required  
  • Experience working directly with DevOps teams is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience managing multiple concurrent projects.
  • Strong background in Scrum/Kanban/Waterfall/Hybrid methodologies.

Hard Skills:  

  • Deep understanding of project lifecycle management (SDLC).
  • Ability to plan, track, and deliver infrastructure and platform engineering projects.
  • Solid understanding of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring/observability and release management.
  • Experience in managing cross-functional teams (5+ team members).
  • Proficient with project management tools: Jira, Confluence, MS Project, Smartsheet.
  • Strong skills in gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and technical requirements (e.g., SRS, Use Cases, User Stories, infrastructure requirements).
  • Ability to read and understand technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and infrastructure specifications independently, without relying solely on the team for translation.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong leadership with a focus on motivating and inspiring the team in high-pressure, fast-moving environments.
  • Proven ability to create a shared sense of purpose, aligning team members around common goals and product vision.
  • Skilled in building trust and psychological safety within distributed and hybrid teams.
  • Encourages a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Experienced in managing through ambiguity, providing clarity and focus during shifting priorities or requirement changes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management: able to align interests between tech and business teams.
  • High emotional intelligence; strong listener and facilitator who resolves conflicts constructively.
  • Clear and persuasive communicator in both business and technical contexts.
  • Credible with engineers: able to earn technical trust based on hands-on background rather than authority alone.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the DevOps team to develop, maintain, and improve infrastructure and processes.

  • Bridge communication between business, development and DevOps teams.

description:

Education & Experience:

— Hands-on experience with at least one TradFi asset class (FX, futures, equities) and / or equivalent crypto asset classes; both maker and taker strategies

Core Technical Skills:

— Advanced probability, statistics, time-series analysis, optimization; strict validation discipline (multiple testing, out-of-sample hygiene, live–sim parity)

— Market microstructure: order-book dynamics, queue position, fill probability, adverse selection and markouts, market impact

— Expert Python (NumPy, pandas/Polars, PyTorch); working C++ or Rust for latency-critical components

— Tick-data engineering at scale: columnar stores, cross-venue normalization, data-quality control

Market Knowledge:

— Crypto microstructure: CEX matching engines and fee schedules, perpetuals (funding, mark price, liquidation/ADL), cross-venue arbitrage, DEX/AMM basics

— TradFi microstructure: FX ECN mechanics (firm vs last-look liquidity, prime brokerage), listed futures; low-latency architecture (tick-to-trade path, colocation, exchange protocols)

— Inventory and hedging: quoting models of the Avellaneda–Stoikov class and extensions, multi-asset inventory optimization, hedging, settlement workflows, real-time risk limits and kill switches

Exchange Microstructure & Mechanism Design:

— Maker-taker economics and market-quality measurement: fee-tier and rebate architecture, per-segment elasticity, spread/depth/slippage/markout metrics, defenses against rebate farming and wash trading

— Liquidity program design: obligation-based schemes (two-sided quoting, presence at touch, minimum depth, uptime) and incentive-based schemes (tiered rebates, credit lines, connectivity benefits)

— Maker protection and flow segmentation: markout-based counterparty scoring, retail price improvement (RPI) order types, asymmetric speed bumps and latency floors, minimum quote life, self-match prevention

— Exchange P&L modeling: net fee capture, subsidy budget and payback, LP unit economics from onboarding to self-sufficiency

Mindset & Soft Skills:

— Owner mentality with direct P&L accountability; ships to production and makes honest kill decisions

— Clear written communication with traders, engineers, exchange management, and external LPs

— Compliance discipline across crypto and TradFi market-abuse regimes

 

Responsibilities:

Responsibilities — Liquidity Program:

— Design the program end-to-end: MM tiers, admission criteria, obligations (max spread, min depth, uptime, presence at touch), incentives, and graduation to subsidy-free self-sufficiency

— Optimize the fee schedule for net capture: taker tiers priced to measured elasticity by segment; maker rebates funded from taker fees; safeguards against tier gaming

— Design order-book mechanics for comfortable quoting: tick and lot sizing, post-only / iceberg / RPI order types, self-match prevention, minimum quote life, passive-liquidity protection options

— Build the toxic-flow framework: markout-based flow classification, counterparty scoring, continuous monitoring, access rules or surcharges for consistently toxic takers

— Own the program financial model and roadmap: subsidy budget with payback targets; phases bootstrap → organic profitability → self-sufficiency; a market-quality dashboard as the single source of truth

Responsibilities — Trading Desc:

— Own the strategy roadmap — crypto first, then TradFi FX and futures; design pricing, quoting, hedging, and execution as one portfolio

— Run end-to-end alpha research on tick/order-book, cross-venue, funding/basis, and on-chain data

— Design the inventory-aware hedging framework, portfolio risk limits, and parameter governance

— Partner with engineering on low-latency implementation; validate in high-fidelity simulation and canary deployments

— Own P&L attribution, TCA/markout analysis, and research standards

— Lead the TradFi FX entry research workstream (LSEG FX Spot Matching, Euronext FX).

description:
We are the creators of a new fintech era!

Our mission is to revolutionize the world by making blockchain technology accessible to everyone in everyday life. WhiteBIT is a global team of more than 1,500 professionals united by a shared vision of shaping the future.

Our official partners include Juventus, FC Barcelona, Lifecell, FACEIT, and VISA.

Join us as Managing Director at a MiCAR-regulated company Vienna, Austria!

Requirements

  • The candidate must be a fit and proper person as defined by the Austrian Financial Market Authority (FMA) and the Company's internal Fit & Proper Policy, possessing integrity, competence, and experience suitable for managing a regulated Crypto-Asset Service Provider (CASP).
  • Master's or Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5-7 years of experience in financial services, fintech, or crypto-asset businesses, with direct accountability for AML/CFT compliance outcomes in at least part of that experience.
  • Proven track record in managing regulated financial institutions or compliance-intensive businesses.
  • Strong knowledge of crypto-asset technologies, markets, and regulations.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, or directly overseeing an AML/CFT compliance programme (customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, suspicious activity/transaction reporting) within a regulated financial services or crypto-asset business.
  • Prior experience acting as, or working in close coordination with, an Anti-Money Laundering Officer (AMLO) / Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).
  • Working knowledge of the EU AML/CFT framework beyond its Austrian transposition, including AMLD5/6, the forthcoming AML Regulation (AMLR), and FATF Recommendations as applied to crypto-asset service providers
  • Experience liaising with the Austrian Financial Intelligence Unit (Geldwäschemeldestelle) or an equivalent FIU, including suspicious transaction reporting
  • Strong understanding of regulatory obligations under MiCA/MiCAR and the Austrian legal framework applicable to CASPs, in particular:
  1. Finanzmarkt-Geldwäschegesetz (FM-GwG) - the Austrian Financial Markets Anti-Money Laundering Act; under Art 23 FM-GwG, the Management Board holds overall responsibility for establishing and resourcing adequate AML/CFT internal controls.
  2. Wertpapieraufsichtsgesetz 2018 (WAG 2018) and Zahlungsdienstegesetz 2018 (ZaDiG 2018), relevant to internal audit, governance, and conduct obligations applied to the Company.
  3. Sanktionengesetz (SanktG) and related EU/Austrian sanctions and restrictive measures frameworks.
  4. Austrian Criminal Code (Strafgesetzbuch, StGB) and Finanzstrafgesetz (FinStrG), relevant to personal integrity and "no criminal record" fit & proper requirements.
  5. Wirtschaftliche Eigentümer Registergesetz (WiEReG), relevant to beneficial ownership disclosure obligations of the Company's management.
  6. FMA Rundschreiben (circulars) on internal organisation, risk analysis, and reporting obligations.
  • Being subject to approval by the FMA as fit and proper, as part of the licensing and ongoing supervisory process.
  • Demonstrated personal and professional integrity.
  • No criminal record or history of bankruptcy.
  • Excellent leadership, strategic thinking, and decision-making skills.
  • Fluency in English and German (German is the FMA's official working language for supervisory correspondence, submissions, and on-site meetings).
  • The candidate must reside in Austria and actively participate in day-to-day management. In line with the Company's Governance Policy, the Management Board must at all times include at least two managing directors resident in the EU and approved fit & proper by the FMA, with at least one managing director readily accessible to the FMA at all times and at least one accessible to staff at the Company's seat; managing directors must coordinate leave and travel so both requirements remain met.
  • Willingness and ability to act jointly with the second managing director in representing the Company (four-eye principle) in line with the Company's Articles of Association and Austrian corporate law.

Responsibilities

  • Define and implement the strategic direction of the company in alignment with MiCA requirements.
  • Ensure operational efficiency and scalability of services related to crypto-asset trading, custody, and exchange.
  • Lead high-level business decisions and ensure the financial sustainability of the business.
  • Supervise the preparation of annual reports, board minutes, and oversee external and internal audits.
  • Ensure full and ongoing compliance with the MiCA Regulation, Austrian FMA guidelines, and related EU directives (e.g., AMLD5, PSD2 and DORA), as well as the Austrian FM-GwG, WAG 2018, ZaDiG 2018, SanktG, and WiEReG.
  • Act as the principal point of contact for the regulator, including serving as the managing director designated as readily accessible to the FMA and able to provide requested information at all times, per the Company's Governance Policy.
  • Take direct ownership of the Company's AML/CFT compliance framework, ensuring the adequacy of customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, screening, and suspicious activity/transaction reporting processes, in close coordination with the AMLO and the Chief Compliance Officer.
  • Approve and periodically review the Company's Customer and Country Risk Assessment Methodology and business-wide ML/TF risk assessment, and ensure the AML/CFT function is adequately resourced as required under Art 23 FM-GwG.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting to the Austrian Financial Intelligence Unit (Geldwäschemeldestelle) and full cooperation with law enforcement and regulatory requests relating to money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions.
  • Ensure robust implementation of sanctions screening and asset-freezing obligations under SanktG and applicable EU restrictive measures regulations.
  • Serve as escalation point for material AML/CFT findings, ensuring timely internal escalation to the Management Board and, where legally required, external reporting to competent authorities.
  • Co-chair, together with the other managing director, the bi-weekly Management Board meetings, covering AML/CFT/sanctions matters, business and financial reports, cybersecurity, licensing updates, and HR matters, and ensure minutes are produced and circulated.
  • Ensure the company maintains effective governance, risk, and compliance frameworks, including upholding the Company's Fit & Proper Policy for initial and ongoing suitability assessments of managing directors and Key Function Holders.
  • Oversee the management of prudential safeguards, asset segregation, and security of client funds and crypto-assets.
  • Regularly review the Company's Articles of Association and, where applicable, Management Board by-laws to ensure continued compliance with Austrian and EU regulatory requirements
  • Represent the company to stakeholders, partners, regulators, and investors, acting jointly with the second managing director (four-eye principle) for acts of representation.
  • Sign regulatory submissions and disclosures as required under MiCA, FM-GwG, and national corporate law.
  • Maintain transparency and timely communication with shareholders and board members.
  • Guide the launch of a new business line in the region.

HashPortウォレットとは。 HashPortウォレットはEXPO2025デジタルウォレットの後継として約100万ユーザーを抱える日本で最大のWeb3ウォレットアプリケーションです。今後様々な機能をリリース予定ですが、既存ポイントシステムとの連携やステーブルコイン(JPYC)との連携など、日本に特化した金融UX（ユーザー体験）を強化し、Web3のマスアダプションへ貢献していきます。 2. 期待する役割 ・高い学習意欲と成長への期待: プロダクトのオーナーシップを持って業務に取り組むことを期待しますが、何よりもWeb3プロダクト開発の現場での早期かつ自律的な成長を重視します。社員と同様の開発プロセスを経験しながら、実務レベルのコード品質を学んでいきます。 シニアエンジニアの指導のもとでスキルを磨いていただきます。 ・技術的な幅の拡大： 希望やスキルに応じて、フロントエンド／バックエンド／R&Dのいずれか、または横断的に参加いただけます。 Web3ウォレットを構成する幅広い領域に興味を持ち、積極的な学習を通じて技術の幅を広げます。 3. 具体的な業務内容（適性に応じて決定） ・プロダクト開発（FE/BE） 　- フロントエンド（FE）： React/TypeScriptを用いたモバイルWebアプリの機能実装、UIコンポーネント開発、UX改善を担当します。 　- バックエンド（BE）： Go言語を用いたAPIの開発、AWS上でのデータベース（Aurora/DynamoDB）連携、認証機能の保守を担当します。バックエンド開発を通じて、システムの運用や信頼性設計に関する知識も深めることができます。 ・研究開発（R&D）： 　- 技術調査・論文読解： 暗号理論、Web3分野の最新論文や仕様（EIPsなど）の調査・読解に取り組みます。 　- アウトプット作成： 論文内容の解説記事やブログの執筆、チームへの発表を担当します。 　- PoC実装： 調査結果に基づき、新しい技術やプロトコルの概念実証（Proof of Concept）の実装を担当します。実例としてはオープンソースな暗号ライブラリの多言語移植、zk技術のPoC実装など。

必須スキル

1. 技術要件 ・基礎技術力と学習能力： コンピュータサイエンスの基礎知識（データ構造、アルゴリズムなど）を有し、高い知的好奇心と学習スピードを持っていること。 ・いずれかのモダン技術の経験： React/TypeScript、またはGo言語、またはAWSのいずれかを用いた個人開発・学術研究等の経験。 ・Git/GitHubを利用した基本的なバージョン管理能力。 2. スタンス ・自律性とコミットメント： 指示を待つだけでなく、自ら課題を設定し、解決に向けて粘り強く取り組む姿勢。 ・技術選定への意欲： プロダクトの成功のためにベストな技術を模索する意欲。

歓迎スキル

・モバイルWebアプリケーションフレームワーク（Capacitor/Ionic/React Nativeなど）を用いた開発経験。 ・AWS、Terraformなどクラウドインフラに関する基礎的な知識。 ・Web3、ブロックチェーン技術、暗号理論に関する深い知識。 ・大学、大学院での専門的な研究テーマ（CS、数学、物理など）を持っていること。

求める人物像

1. 知的好奇心と成長意欲の高い方 ・AI活用による生産性向上に積極的な方： AI開発ツール（Copilot, Devinなど）を積極的に活用し、自身の生産性を高める意識を持つ方。 ・チームメンバーからのフィードバックを素直に受け入れ、それを糧に急速な成長を遂げられる方。 2. プロダクトにコミットできる方 ・Web3・ブロックチェーン領域への強い情熱と関心がある方： Web3やブロックチェーン技術そのものの進化に強い情熱を持ち、その技術的な挑戦を楽しめる方。 ・職種間の垣根を越え、プロダクト全体の成功のために貢献したいという意欲がある方。 ・オープンで建設的なコミュニケーションを重視し、活発な技術的な議論に参加できる方。

description:
About us

Bitget is one of the world's leading digital assets ecosystems. With over 120 million registered users, Bitget has one of the most comprehensive suites of blockchain products and services available via bitget.com.

Our mission is to support the growth of the digital assets industry and we believe it represents the future of finance. What we do empowers the future of finance by ensuring secure, efficient and smart digital transactions.

We are one of the fastest growing companies in the digital asset sector. If you are looking for cutting-edge work, where you will have opportunities to develop your career among peers who are experts in their field, and you believe in the future of digital currency, then look no further than Bitget!

What you'll do

  • Responsible for the full-cycle operations of proprietary Omnibus US equity secondary clearing, delivery, and settlement, ensuring accurate and secure settlement of funds and securities.
  • Daily coordination with upstream custodian brokers to complete reconciliation of cash and securities positions; independently investigate, follow up, and close reconciliation breaks.
  • Monitor daily settlement status, handle settlement exceptions such as failed deliveries and pending trades, and coordinate internal and external resources to mitigate settlement risks.
  • Verify and execute various US corporate actions (dividends, stock splits, mergers, etc.) and transfer settlements, ensuring company entitlements.
  • Strictly comply with US equity settlement rules and internal policies; proactively monitor, investigate, and report settlement risks.
  • Proficiently operate internal clearing and settlement systems, complete data entry, dispatch settlement instructions, confirm reconciliations, and participate in system automation optimization.
  • Generate daily/weekly/monthly settlement reports, break ledgers, and risk data; cooperate with finance and compliance for audit and inspection.
  • Collaborate with trading, risk, technology, and finance teams to optimize settlement processes and enhance overall operational efficiency.

What you'll need

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in finance, accounting, economics, mathematics, or related fields.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience in US equities clearing and settlement; experience with proprietary Omnibus account settlement preferred; familiarity with US equity trading and settlement mechanisms.
  • Proficient in US secondary clearing processes, broker reconciliation, and break resolution; familiarity with corporate actions and transfer settlement workflows.
  • Good English reading and writing skills, able to independently review offshore settlement documents and coordinate with overseas brokers; skilled in advanced Excel data processing.
  • Strong data sensitivity, attention to detail, resilience under pressure, strong risk awareness, cross-functional communication, and fast learning abilities.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience in US equity settlement at overseas brokers, top financial institutions, or proprietary trading firms;
  • Possession of securities, fund, or other relevant financial industry certifications;
  • Knowledge of clearing and settlement operations related to derivatives or cryptocurrencies is a plus.

岗位职责：

  • 负责自营Omnibus美股业务二级清算、交割结算全流程运营，保障资金、证券交割准确安全。
  • 每日对接上游托管券商，完成现金、证券头寸对账，独立排查、跟进、闭环处理对账差异（Break）。
  • 监控每日结算状态，处理交割失败、待处理交易等结算异常，协调内外部资源降低交割风险。
  • 负责美股各类公司行动（分红、拆股、合并等）及转仓清算的核对与落地，保障公司权益。
  • 严格遵守美股结算规则及内部制度，做好结算风险监控、排查与上报。
  • 熟练操作内部清结算系统，完成数据录入、结算指令下发、对账确认，参与系统自动化优化。
  • 输出日/周/月结算报表、差异台账、风险数据，配合财务、合规完成审计核查。
  • 联动交易、风控、技术、财务团队，优化结算流程，提升整体运营效率。

任职要求：

  • 本科及以上学历，金融、会计、经济、数理相关专业优先。
  • 3-5年美股清结算实操经验，有自营Omnibus账户结算经验优先，熟悉美股交易与交割机制。
  • 精通美股二级清算流程、券商对账及Break处理逻辑，熟悉公司行动、转仓清算流程。
  • 英文读写良好，可独立阅读海外结算文件、对接境外券商；熟练Excel高级数据处理功能。
  • 数据敏感度高、细致严谨、抗压性强，具备极强风险意识、跨部门沟通能力与业务学习能力。

加分项

  • 具备海外券商、头部金融机构、自营交易公司美股结算从业经验；
  • 持有证券、基金等金融相关从业证书；
  • 了解衍生品、加密货币相关清结算业务优先。

Why Bitget?

  • Bitget is the world's leading web 3 platform for copy trading and one of the world's largest and most respected exchanges
  • We are a global company with staff members from over 50 different countries and regions
  • We are growing and looking for world-class ambitious talents to help us continue this journey
  • We have a streamlined structure that empowers employees to work efficiently, delivering the best results in a short timeframe
  • We offer competitive salaries and benefits
  • Blockchain technology and digital assets have the potential to change finance in a way no other technology can - be part of it!

If you are ambitious and believe that digital assets could be the next financial and technological revolution, please apply!

description:
Marketnode is a digital market infrastructure (DMI) operator backed by Euroclear, HSBC, SGX Group and Temasek. We believe in the power of programmable assets and that traditional financial instruments will be originated, transacted and served better leveraging emerging technologies such as blockchain. Our approach to building market infrastructure is one of partnership with the industry and in 2024 have successfully launched our first market-wide platform for funds, with credit and structured products to follow 2025 onwards.
At Marketnode, our DMI suite covers the following:
  • Data services: AI powered structured data and extraction tools
  • Funds & transaction management: operating Fundnode, a funds transaction management and settlement platform
  • Digital Assets: multi-asset tokenization, record keeping and asset servicing
Having recently closed our Series A investment with major financial institutions such as HSBC, Marketnode is now well positioned for it’s next growth phase and is looking for a Test Engineer leading overall delivery efforts for our platform and data services offerings.
We are looking for a passionate and experienced Test Engineer – Automation to help ensure the quality, reliability and scalability of our platform and data services.
If you are passionate about software quality, automation and solving complex technical challenges, this is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of financial technology, capital markets and emerging technologies such as blockchain and digital assets.
The role is responsible for planning, designing, executing, and maintaining test activities to ensure product quality across functional and integrated systems. This role involves collaborating closely with developers, business analysts, and other QA team members to identify issues early, improve test coverage, and contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes and automation practices.
If you are passionate about software quality and excited by the opportunity to work at the intersection of capital markets, blockchain, and financial technology, we'd love to hear from you.
This role is ideal for someone with strong TypeScript automation skills, API testing experience, and an interest in blockchain, Web3, digital assets, or fintech.
The role is based in Bangalore, India, and reports to the Lead QA Engineer.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze user stories, functional requirements, and technical designs to create comprehensive test scenarios.
  • Design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Build and maintain automation frameworks using TypeScript with Playwright (preferred) or similar modern automation tools.
  • Perform API and integration testing using tools such as Postman, Playwright API, or similar.
  • Validate blockchain and Web3 workflows, including digital asset transactions, smart contract interactions, and API integrations where applicable.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using tools such as JIRA or Github.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and QA engineers to ensure timely resolution of issues.
  • Support non-functional testing, including performance, security, and usability testing where required.
  • Contribute to QA best practices, test strategies, automation improvements, and continuous integration processes.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or similar to improve QA productivity.
Experience
  • 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance.
  • At least 2+ years of experience in test automation using TypeScript.
  • Experience testing web applications, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Experience working on Blockchain, Web3, Digital Assets, Cryptocurrency, or Financial Market Infrastructure products is highly preferred.
  • Experience working in Banking, FinTech, or other regulated financial environments is an advantage.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Hyperbolic Labs is on a mission to democratize AI by breaking down the barriers to computing power with our Open-Access AI Cloud. By making better use of idle computing resources across the globe, we offer an innovative GPU marketplace and AI inference service that promise affordability and accessibility for all. As pioneers at the intersection of AI and open-source technology, we believe in an open future where AI innovation is limited only by imagination, not by access to resources. We're looking for forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for making AI universally accessible, secure, and affordable. Join us in building a platform that empowers innovators everywhere to turn their visionary AI projects into reality.

About the Role

When a customer's GPU cluster has a problem, you are the first engineer they talk to, and most of the time you are the only one they need to. You own the ticket from the first response to the resolution, you own the clock against our SLA, and you keep ownership even when the problem needs deeper help.

This is not a ticket routing job. You will be in Linux every day, on real infrastructure, fixing real customer problems. The people who do this well here move into the Forward Deployed Engineer role, and we will build that path with you deliberately.

Who You Are

  • Ticket ownership, end to end. You own every ticket you pick up, including after it escalates. You do not hand off, you pull in the engineer you need and stay on it until the customer is working.

  • The SLA clock. First response, severity classification, and keeping us honest against our response commitments. You are the person who knows where every open issue stands.

  • First technical response and triage. Reproduce the problem, gather the logs and configuration that matter, and make the first call on whether the fault is ours or the provider's.

  • Customer environment access and configuration. SSH key and access issues, NFS mounts and storage, quotas, security groups, container and driver questions, billing and account questions.

  • Runbook execution and authoring. Run the documented play when there is one. When you solve something new, write the runbook so the next person does not escalate it.

  • Documentation. Keep our customer-facing docs and internal knowledge base current. Most repeat tickets are a documentation gap.

  • Very strong Linux experience and daily work in the CLI.

  • Experience owning tickets against a response SLA in cloud, hosting, or infrastructure support.

  • Solid networking and storage fundamentals: SSH, NFS and mounts, DNS, firewalls and security groups.

  • Working familiarity with GPU workloads: nvidia-smi, drivers, CUDA, containers.

  • Clear and fast written communication under time pressure. Customers read what you write while they are blocked.

  • Good judgment about the limits of your own knowledge, and a bias toward escalating early with a complete picture rather than late with a guess.

  • Comfortable working across time zones and with an on-call rotation for critical issues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ticketing and on-call tooling (Zendesk, Linear, PagerDuty, or similar).

  • Scripting in bash or Python to automate repeat work.

  • Exposure to Slurm, Kubernetes, or Docker in a multi-tenant environment.

  • Background in GPU cloud, HPC, or a hardware-adjacent support org.

Hyperbolic is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Capital Markets Lead
location: San Francisco, CA, USA, San Francisco County, California, United States, North America
description:
Who We Are

Hyperbolic Labs is on a mission to democratize AI by breaking down the barriers to computing power with our Open-Access AI Cloud. By making better use of idle computing resources across the globe, we offer an innovative GPU marketplace and AI inference service that promise affordability and accessibility for all. As pioneers at the intersection of AI and open-source technology, we believe in an open future where AI innovation is limited only by imagination, not by access to resources. We're looking for forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for making AI universally accessible, secure, and affordable. Join us in building a platform that empowers innovators everywhere to turn their visionary AI projects into reality.

About the Role

You'll work directly with the Head of Finance and CEO to raise the capital that funds our compute supply, across conventional facilities and structures that don't have a standard playbook yet. Compute is an unusual asset class. It has contracted cash flows, a real residual value, a depreciation curve nobody agrees on, and a lender base that is still forming an opinion about it. You'll build the financing architecture around it, and make the case to a credit committee that our receivables are money good. This is a builder's seat, not a maintenance seat - there is no existing facility to administer, and you will originate the first ones.

You'll originate and structure debt capital to fund vendor down payments and capacity commitments, spanning bank revolvers, private credit and non-bank facilities, receivables- and contract-backed structures, SPV and project-style financings, and vendor and equipment financing. You'll own the lender and investor relationship map, run raises end to end from positioning through definitive documentation, and sit in the redlines on covenants, lien priority, DACA mechanics, borrowing base definitions, and advance rates. You'll own the financing side of our contract-level model and bring leadership a defensible recommendation rather than a menu, support the concurrent equity round without letting the debt and equity tracks collide, manage post-close lender reporting and compliance, and work closely with the teams negotiating vendor supply and customer contracts so that what we sign is financeable.

In your first 90 days, you'll know our unit economics and contract mechanics, have a mapped and prioritized lender universe, and have first meetings underway. By six months, you'll have a term sheet in hand for a facility that funds vendor down payments on terms we'd sign again. By twelve months, capital is no longer the constraint on how much capacity we can commit to.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years in capital markets, corporate development, or institutional fundraising; 10+ preferred

  • You have raised institutional capital before - specifically from institutional LPs for a hedge fund, private equity firm, or venture capital firm - and you can name the relationships you'd bring

  • Investment bank capital markets experience, ideally debt: DCM, leveraged finance, structured finance, private capital markets, or a financial sponsors group

  • Existing relationships with bank, non-bank, and private credit lenders active in the AI space

  • Real fluency in credit documentation and structure - comfortable arguing about first-lien vs. second-lien, intercreditor terms, cash sweeps, and what a lender actually means when they ask for control over an account

  • Strong financial modeling skills; you can build the facility model yourself and defend every assumption in it

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity, a small team, and no analyst bench

Preferred Qualifications

  • You've raised a Series B or Series C at a startup - as an operator, not an advisor

  • Exposure to asset-backed, equipment, infrastructure, or project finance

  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure, data centers, semiconductors, or energy - or a demonstrated ability to get up the curve on a technical market fast

Hyperbolic is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

  • Contribute to system architecture and technical design discussions
  • Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL
  • Build cloud-native applications on AWS and/or Azure
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, testing, and code quality
  • Improve developer experience, tooling, and engineering processes
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
  • Champion testing, documentation, and engineering best practices
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to a strong engineering culture
  • Collaborate closely with product and business teams to shape solutions
  • Provide L3 production support, troubleshooting issues and ensuring platform stability
  • Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives
  •  
  • What We're Looking For
  • Experience
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong experience building scalable backend systems
  • Experience working in product-based or high-growth technology environments
  • Exposure to fintech, financial services, data platforms, or transaction systems is a plus
  • Core Technical Skills
  • Strong proficiency in Java
  • Experience with Spring Framework / Spring Boot
  • Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
  • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs
  • Strong understanding of relational databases such as PostgreSQL and/or MySQL
  • Experience with AWS and/or Azure
  • Familiarity with software testing principles and frameworks
  • Strong understanding of Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Nice to Have
  • Experience with microservices and event-driven architectures
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar
  • Experience with containerisation technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Exposure to blockchain, tokenisation, or digital assets
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
 
What Success Looks Like
  • Deliver scalable, high-quality features across backend and frontend systems
  • Improve developer productivity and engineering standards
  • Contribute to architecture and technical decision-making
  • Build reliable, secure, and maintainable platforms
  • Collaborate effectively across teams to deliver business outcomes

Head of Franklin Crypto Capital Formation
description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.


From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.


Head of Franklin Crypto Capital Formation

The Head of Franklin Crypto Capital Formation function is dedicated to growing the firm’s investor base, driving capital formation and fostering robust, transparent, productive relationships with our investors. Our mission is to ensure that our Limited Partners (LPs) and other stakeholders, including the global distribution teams, are well-informed, engaged, and confident in their investments with Franklin Crypto. The team works collaboratively with the division’s leadership, investment professionals, global distribution team and external stakeholders to ensure a cohesive and effective investor relations strategy, one anchored in best-in-class client experience.

Our firm executes a diverse array of scalable, institutional investment strategies spanning open- and closed-end funds, including hedge funds, venture and private credit funds, across seed stage, early venture stage, and public crypto token and equity investing. The Capital Formation function serves to (a) lead capital formation across our full platform of cryptonative open- and closed-end funds, hedge funds, venture and private credit funds sourcing commitments from both cryptonative and traditional institutional allocators and (b) manage deep and productive relationships across the entirety of the LP base with a focus on securing additional tier 1, institutional long-term backers, and (c) deliver an excellent end-to-end investor experience by ensuring a seamless LP experience.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Head of Crypto Capital Formation to lead fundraising across Franklin Crypto’s full fund platform, expand our institutional investor base, and own the end-to-end investor experience from first conversation through subscription, redemption, and ongoing servicing. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in institutional fundraising and investor relations and servicing, a robust network of both cryptonative and traditional institutional investors and managers (including pensions, endowments, foundations, OCIOs, fund-of-funds, family offices, and crypto-native allocators), and a clear passion for the crypto and Web3 landscape. The role will report directly into the Head of Franklin Crypto.

Our mission is to ensure that our Limited Partners (LPs) and other stakeholders, including the global distribution teams, are well-informed, engaged, and confident in their investments with Franklin Crypto. The team works collaboratively with the division’s leadership, investment professionals, global distribution team and external stakeholders to ensure a cohesive and effective investor relations strategy, one anchored in best-in-class client experience.

Our firm executes a diverse array of scalable, institutional investment strategies spanning open- and closed-end funds, including hedge funds, venture and private credit funds, across seed stage, early venture stage, and public crypto token and equity investing. The Capital Formation function serves to lead capital formation across our full platform of cryptonative open- and closed-end funds, hedge funds, venture and private credit funds, manage deep and productive relationships across the entirety of the LP base, and deliver an excellent end-to-end investor experience.

Responsibilities Include

Capital Formation

  • Lead the end-to-end capital raising process across Franklin Crypto’s full platform of open- and closed-end funds, including hedge funds, venture funds, private credit and other alternative funds, building durable relationships with both cryptonative and traditional institutional investors.

  • Develop compelling investor presentations, reports, and other materials to effectively communicate investment strategies, performance, and opportunities.

  • Coordinate and manage investor meetings, roadshows, and other fundraising events.

Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary liaison with Franklin Templeton’s global distribution team, ensuring they are updated and equipped with products, content and investment materials.

  • Maintain deep and productive relationships with LPs, ensuring consistent and effective communication.

  • Facilitate ongoing dialogue between the firm's leadership and the investor community.

  • Serve as the escalation point of contact for investor inquiries, providing timely and accurate information.

Onboarding, Subscriptions & Client Experience

  • Working closely with Private Fund Services, ensure a frictionless investor onboarding experience, partnering with Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Operations to streamline KYC/AML, subscription documentation, and fund-administrator workflows across all vehicles.

  • Working closely with Private Fund Services, ensure a seamless subscription and redemption process for open- and closed-end funds end-to-end, ensuring accurate, timely execution and a high-touch experience that meets institutional standards.

  • Own the client experience from first conversation through ongoing servicing, building scalable systems, playbooks, and feedback loops that delight LPs and reinforce Franklin Crypto’s reputation for institutional excellence.

Reporting and Communications

  • Deliver timely and comprehensive updates on fund performance, market trends, and key developments within the firm and the broader crypto/Web3 ecosystem.

  • Produce regular newsletters and other communications to keep investors informed and engaged.

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory and reporting requirements.

Investor Education

  • Educate global institutional investors on crypto markets, investment strategies, and the potential risks and rewards.

  • Organize and conduct educational webinars and events to deepen investor understanding and engagement.

Internal Distribution Education

  • Educate Franklin Templeton’s global distribution teams on crypto markets, investment strategies, and the potential risks and rewards.

  • Organize and conduct educational webinars and events to deepen the distribution team’s understanding and engagement.

What Will Help You Be Successful in This Role

  • Proven track record of successfully raising capital across multiple fund structures and owning ongoing LP relationship management.

  • Minimum of 10+ years experience in Investor Relations and/or Business Development and training from a top tier firm.

  • Demonstrated interest in blockchain, crypto or web3.

  • Established network and credibility across both cryptonative LPs and traditional institutional allocators.

  • Working knowledge of fund operations across hedge fund and venture fund structures.

  • Superior verbal and written communication skills.

  • Evidence of working in a collegial and fast growth environment.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Strengths

  • Prior role in Capital Formation at a crypto firm.

  • Experience raising capital across a multi-strategy platform spanning open-end, closed-end, hedge, and venture vehicles.

  • Direct experience overseeing investor onboarding and subscription/redemption operations.

  • Series 7 and 63 (or willingness to obtain).

Own the automated test strategy across our mobile apps (Flutter, iOS & Android), web applications, and APIs. Build and maintain reliable test suites that run in CI on every change - and own the pipelines they run in. Partner with developers and product to shift quality left, cut manual regression effort, and keep releases fast and safe.

Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the automation framework across mobile, web, and API layers - shared abstractions, reusable fixtures, test data factories, stable locators

  • Build and maintain automated suites for mobile (Patrol, Maestro), web (Playwright or Cypress), and API (REST/GraphQL, incl. negative and contract cases)

  • Own the test stages of CI/CD pipelines: parallel execution, quality gates, reporting, and test environment management

  • Write component and visual regression tests together with developers; review their test code in PRs

  • Drive down flakiness - root-cause and fix unstable tests rather than retrying blindly

  • Manage execution targets: real devices and emulators (Firebase Test Lab, BrowserStack) and browser grids

  • Define and report quality metrics: automation coverage, flake rate, suite runtime, escaped defects

  • Write test plans; run exploratory testing on new features before automating

  • Verify release candidates (TestFlight / Play internal testing / web staging) and run release sign-off

  • Own the bug lifecycle: reproduce, isolate, report with logs and recordings, verify fixes, track regressions

  • Advocate for testability in architecture - test IDs, deterministic state, DI that supports mocking

  • Mentor junior QA; raise testability concerns early in grooming and design review

  • Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate test authoring and maintenance - with human review as a non-negotiable gate

Nice to have

  • Flutter/Dart specifically; golden/visual regression testing

  • Performance testing (app start time, Core Web Vitals, k6/JMeter)

  • Docker and containerized test environments

  • Security testing awareness (OWASP Top 10 / MASVS, certificate pinning)

  • Fintech or blockchain experience; PDPA awareness

  • Test management tooling (TestRail, Xray, Zephyr)

Qualification:

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT, or related field - or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years hands-on building and maintaining test automation

  • Proven automation experience in at least two of: mobile, web, API - with willingness to cover all three

  • Hands-on experience writing test code in at least one of TypeScript, Dart, or Python

  • Demonstrated ownership of automation inside CI/CD pipelines - configuring, maintaining, and debugging the jobs, not just writing tests

  • Solid test design judgment: risk-based prioritization, and knowing when automation isn't worth the cost

  • Strong debugging skills; able to tell app bug from test bug from environment issue

  • Git proficiency in a PR-based workflow

  • Excellent communication and ability to lead technical discussions

title: 事業開発／プロジェクトマネージャー（オンチェーン金融）
description:
会社紹介

Startale Groupは「世界をオンチェーン化することで、次の文明を創る」をミッションに掲げる、オンチェーン金融領域の日本発グローバルスタートアップです。Sony・SBIなどからシリーズAで約100億円を調達し、チェーン、ステーブルコイン、決済、アプリまでを垂直統合で提供しています。

このポジションについて

Startaleのオンチェーン金融事業を、ビジネスサイドから前に進めるポジションです。ビジネス全般の受け皿として、社内外を巻き込む案件のプロジェクトマネジメントを軸に、事業開発までを担っていただきます。

扱う対象は固定していません。日本円ステーブルコイン「JPYSC」、L1ブロックチェーン「Strium」、新規のオンチェーン金融プロダクトなど、その時点で会社が最も前に進めたい案件に入っていただきます。領域が動くことを前提とした役割です。

仕事内容

  • パートナー案件のプロジェクトマネジメント。社内外を巻き込んだ遂行と案件管理
  • 論点整理、要件の言語化、関係者の合意形成、進行と納期の管理
  • 事業開発。機会創出から関係構築・提案・契約まで
  • 顧客・パートナーのニーズを、プロダクトの要件へ翻訳
  • 事業として成立するスキーム・座組みの設計
  • 東京・ニューヨーク・シンガポールのグローバルチームとの協業

必須要件

  • 社会人経験5年以上
  • 日本語ネイティブレベル。英語でのコミュニケーションが可能なこと
  • 複数の関係者が関わる仕事を、自分で完了まで持っていったご経験（領域・職種は問いません）
  • 変化の速い環境を面白がれること

歓迎要件

  • コンサルティングファームでのプロジェクトデリバリーのご経験。金融機関向け案件のご経験があればとくに歓迎します
  • 金融機関（銀行・証券など）でのご実務経験
  • 大手Tech企業でのプロジェクトマネジメント、またはPMOのご経験。金融業界担当のご経験があればとくに歓迎します
  • 金融機関向けのクライアント営業・事業開発のご経験、または大手金融機関とのネットワーク
  • 証券会社などでの商品組成のご経験
  • プラットフォーム側（AWS/Azure 等）での決済系プロジェクトのご経験
  • ブロックチェーン・デジタルアセットへの関心・知見

求める人物像

  1. 士魂商才 - 世界で本気で勝ちにいく気概と、誇れるやり方を両立できる方
  2. オーナーシップ - 前例のない環境でも自ら優先順位を決め、成果に責任を持てる方
  3. 地頭とやり切る力 - 知識の量ではなく、初めての論点でも筋を立てて前に進められる方
  4. 素直さとアンラーン - 変化を面白がり、学び直せる方
  5. グローバルマインドセット - 難しい環境でもアグレッシブに動ける方

待遇・働き方

  • 想定年収：1,050万円〜1,800万円（賞与込み）／ストックオプション制度あり
  • ご希望に応じて業務委託での契約も可能：USD 85,000〜145,000+（変動報酬込み）／ストックオプションあり
  • ストックオプション：入社後(試用期間後)、当社規程に基づき付与します。選考の過程で、付与株数・行使価格・直近ラウンドの評価額を開示してご説明します
  • 勤務地：東京・六本木一丁目（ハイブリッド）
  • 年1回の全社ワーケーション、不定期オフサイト
  • 裁量休暇制度、AI ツールへの投資

選考プロセス

  1. 書類選考
  2. 英語でのカジュアル面談（英語、基本的な Capability、スタートアップへの志向性を確認。場合によっては日英で2度実施します）
  3. 招待制イベント（Startale を知っていただくための場です。少人数開催のため、フィットする方をご案内します）
  4. 一次面接
  5. 二次面接
  6. CEO 面接
  7. オファー面談

オンライン中心です。
