description:
Open role

AI-Native / AI-Forward Developer

An AI-native developer who uses coding agents as a real part of how they build, and still owns architecture, review, and what ships.

EngineeringRemoteFull-time

Apply

Ready to explore this role with us?

Apply now

Takes about 10 minutes.

Role Overview

Job Description

About IMPOSSIBLE

IMPOSSIBLE is a crypto investment platform. We focus on high-quality, fair, accessible opportunities for people around the world.

We try to make DeFi easier to use: investing more transparent, trading cheaper, and yield easier to reach. Through our accelerator and launchpad, we help new crypto projects come to market and give users deals we have actually looked at.

You will work across the group: IMPOSSIBLE, Rarible, and our AI company Impossibuild. The work sits in AI, crypto, DeFi, marketplaces, and whatever we build next.

The Role

We want an AI-native developer. Someone who uses AI as a serious way to ship, not someone who pastes a question into ChatGPT once in a while.

You have changed how you build around coding agents and modern tools, and you still have your own judgment. You can tell when the model is helping and when it is making a mess.

AI can write the code. You still own the engineering.

  • Break a hard problem down and give the model the right context.
  • Use coding agents on larger pieces of work, not just one-off snippets.
  • Steer them when they assume the wrong thing or wander off.
  • Read and challenge the code they produce.
  • Debug it, test it, and check that it actually works.
  • Make the architecture and product calls yourself.
  • Know when AI is useful, and when you should just write it.
  • Move faster without getting sloppy on security, reliability, or the next person who has to maintain it.

What you'll work on

Depending on the project, you might sit in IMPOSSIBLE, Rarible, Impossibuild, or another company in the group.

  • Ship AI-powered product features.
  • Build internal agents and tools that save people time.
  • Put LLMs into frontend and backend systems.
  • Build AI workflows for research, risk, trading, and ops.
  • Work with wallets, smart contracts, and on-chain data.
  • Build around DeFi, marketplaces, trading, and crypto infrastructure.
  • Use AI to personalize how people use the product.
  • Build retrieval systems, data pipelines, APIs, and automations.
  • Try new models, agents, frameworks, and APIs.
  • Improve prompts, context, evals, latency, cost, and reliability.
  • Prototype quickly and ship new AI-native products.

What we're looking for

Shipping real products matters more than matching every item on this list. Crypto, blockchain, or DeFi experience is a plus. Strong engineers who can pick up the domain are welcome too.

Engineering

  • Python
  • TypeScript / JavaScript
  • Go
  • React / Next.js
  • Node.js and backend frameworks
  • APIs and services
  • SQL and modern databases
  • Cloud infrastructure
  • Git, CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and building things that are safe to run

AI tools

  • LLMs and LLM APIs
  • AI coding agents
  • Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar
  • Agent frameworks and tool calling
  • Vector databases and RAG
  • Prompt and context engineering
  • Eval and observability
  • MCP and agent workflows

Proof of work, not just a resume

We care more about what you have built than where you worked or what degree you have.

Send projects, GitHub repos, live products, demos, open source, experiments, or write-ups. Then answer these three questions in the form.

  1. 1.Show us something you built where AI clearly changed how fast or how well you could do it. What tools and workflow did you use? What did the model do well, and what did you have to steer, fix, or rethink?
  2. 2.Tell us about a time an AI coding tool gave you an answer that looked right and was wrong. How did you catch it? What was actually wrong? What did you change after that?
  3. 3.If you had 48 hours to ship a production feature, how would you use AI from idea through architecture, implementation, review, testing, deploy, and monitoring?

How to apply

Click Apply now. Include your resume, proof of work, and answers to the three questions above. Extra credit if the application itself shows how you think.

We read every application. We only write back to people we want to take further.

title: Rarible Product Manager
description:
Open role

Rarible Product Manager

A product manager who actually likes AI, marketplaces, and collectibles, and can take a messy idea through spec, prototype, launch, and what you learn after.

RaribleRemoteFull-time

Apply

Ready to explore this role with us?

Apply now

Takes about 10 minutes.

Role Overview

Job Description

About Rarible

Rarible builds at the intersection of digital ownership, marketplaces, collectibles, and Web3.

We have spent years on products and infrastructure for NFT and digital collectible ecosystems. We want a product manager who is excited about where AI, marketplaces, communities, and collectibles go next.

You will work with product, design, engineering, and business on the next generation of Rarible products.

The Role

We want a product manager who genuinely likes AI, marketplaces, and collectibles.

Someone who tries new consumer products, plays with new AI tools, understands why people collect things, and has instincts around marketplaces, liquidity, discovery, identity, and community.

You do not need a whole career in crypto. You should care about how AI is changing both how we build and what people want, and you should want to build for collectors, creators, communities, and marketplaces.

The loop we care about is idea, user problem, spec, prototype, build, launch, learn. Then do it again, quickly.

What you'll do

  • Own products and features from the first sketch through launch and the work after.
  • Spot new opportunities in AI, marketplaces, and digital collectibles.
  • Work closely with design and engineering and actually ship.
  • Talk to users, collectors, creators, partners, and communities about what they need.
  • Turn a fuzzy idea into a clear product decision.
  • Set priorities, roadmaps, success metrics, and experiments.
  • Look at marketplace behavior, funnels, liquidity, engagement, and retention.
  • Make discovery, buying, selling, collecting, and portfolios better.
  • Ask how AI can help search, discovery, personalization, curation, creation, and ops.
  • Prototype with AI tools before you spend a lot of engineering time.
  • Keep up with AI, crypto, consumer apps, gaming, collectibles, and marketplaces.
  • Work across teams until the insight is a shipped product.

What we're looking for

A perfect resume matters less than taste, curiosity, ownership, and proof you can build things people want. You will probably fit if:

  • You are always trying new AI tools and products.
  • You have opinions about what makes a consumer product great.
  • You understand marketplaces, or you are fascinated by them.
  • You like collectibles, digital or physical, and can explain why people collect.
  • You are interested in NFTs, digital ownership, crypto, gaming, or creator economies.
  • You can take a messy problem and turn it into a direction the team can build.
  • You are comfortable sitting with engineers and designers.
  • You can tell a cool demo from something people will actually use.
  • You use data, and you still make a call when the data is incomplete.
  • You move quickly and you are fine testing an idea before it is polished.
  • You can say no.
  • You are fine in a fast, remote team.

How you use AI

AI should not just be a line on the roadmap. We want someone who thinks about how it changes the way products get built, and what those products can become.

You do not need to be an engineer. You should be curious about how the tech works and comfortable with technical people.

  • Research and looking at competitors
  • Writing specs
  • Quick prototypes
  • Making sense of user feedback
  • Exploring data
  • Trying UX and copy
  • Brainstorming and poking holes in ideas
  • Testing a concept before you ask engineering to build it
  • Working more tightly with engineering and design

Nice to have

  • You have worked on a marketplace.
  • You have launched a consumer product.
  • You have worked in crypto, NFTs, gaming, fintech, or creator platforms.
  • You have built something with AI yourself.
  • You collect something and can explain why.
  • You understand marketplace liquidity and network effects.
  • You have a good eye for product design.
  • You have side projects or experiments you can show.
  • You can point to something you shipped and say what you got right and what you got wrong.

Proof of work, not just a resume

When you apply, send something that shows how you think as a product person. Answer these three questions in the form.

  1. 1.Which marketplace or collectible product do you think is unusually well designed, and why? What do they understand about their users that other people miss?
  2. 2.How do you think AI will change marketplaces and collectibles over the next 2-3 years? We care more about how you think than about a perfect prediction.
  3. 3.Tell us about a product or feature you took from idea to launch. What did you own? What did you decide? What did you learn once real users touched it?

How to apply

Click Apply now. Include your resume, proof of work, and answers to the three questions above. Extra credit if the application itself shows how you think about product.

We read every application. We only write back to people we want to take further.

At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.


From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.


About the department:

  • The Digital Product Management - GOE team develops and manages Franklin Templeton's proprietary Goals Optimization Engine, a patented business-to-business-to-consumer wealth management platform used across global markets. The team combines expertise in product management, investment solutions, research, technology, and client delivery to create innovative digital wealth experiences. Team members work closely with investment, engineering, sales, compliance, legal, and customer-facing teams to deliver scalable solutions that improve client outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to core digital wealth products, support new product capabilities, and work on emerging technology initiatives within a regulated financial services environment.

How you will add value?

Product Management - Digital Investment Solutions, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, and Emerging Technology Capabilities:

  • You will analyze business needs across advisory, retirement, and private wealth segments.

  • You will support product lifecycle activities from discovery and requirements definition through launch and adoption.

  • You will conduct user, stakeholder, and market research to identify opportunities and define product priorities.

  • You will translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development priorities.

  • You will partner with engineering, design, data, and investment teams to deliver scalable product enhancements.

  • You will evaluate opportunities involving emerging financial technologies, including digital assets, tokenization, blockchain-enabled workflows, and related client experiences.

  • You will support go-to-market planning, internal enablement, and adoption activities across channels and regions.

Deployments, Risk Management, and Documentation:

  • You will coordinate client and partner deployment activities, including readiness planning, training, and post-launch feedback.

  • You will collaborate with investment teams on portfolio solutions and digital investment experiences.

  • You will work with legal, compliance, risk, and operations teams to assess product considerations in regulated markets.

  • You will maintain product documentation, release notes, requirements, and implementation materials.

  • You will support testing, user acceptance, and release readiness for product enhancements.

  • You will define success metrics, develop dashboards, and monitor product performance and adoption.

  • You will contribute to business planning, competitive analysis, and roadmap discussions.

What will help you be successful in this role?

Experience, Education & Certifications:

  • MBA and STEM undergraduate degree from a leading institution.

Technical Skills:

Soft Skills:

  • Data-driven decision-making and strong product judgment.

  • Self-motivated and comfortable working through ambiguity.

title: Senior Compliance Officer

description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.


From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.


About the Position

The successful candidate will support the firm's compliance program across registered private equity funds, private debt funds, and exchange-traded funds (ETFs), ensuring adherence to applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies. This role will work closely with investment, operations, legal, product, and distribution teams to identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risks while supporting the continued growth of the firm's investment platform.

How you will add value

Regulatory Compliance

  • Support the implementation and ongoing administration of the firm's compliance program under Rule 38a-1 of the Investment Company Act of 1940.

  • Monitor compliance with applicable SEC regulations, Investment Advisers Act requirements, fund governing documents, and internal policies.

  • Assist in the development, maintenance, and enhancement of compliance policies and procedures.

  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the firm's business and products.

Registered Private Funds Compliance (Equity, Debt, Venture Capital and Infrastructure)

  • Support compliance oversight for existing registered closed-end private equity and private credit/debt funds as well as new products.

  • Monitor compliance with fund investment restrictions, conflicts of interest policies, valuation procedures, and side letter obligations.

  • Coordinate periodic compliance testing and surveillance activities related to private fund operations.

  • Assist with board reporting

ETF Compliance

  • Support compliance oversight of ETF products, monitoring adherence to regulatory requirements and support in the launch of new products.

  • Coordinate with portfolio management, capital markets, operations, and service providers regarding compliance matters affecting ETF operations.

  • Experience with digital asset ETFs, crypto and tokenized funds, and stablecoins.

  • Assist with board reporting.

Compliance Monitoring & Testing

  • Conduct periodic compliance reviews and testing of key controls.

  • Investigate potential compliance issues and assist in remediation efforts.

  • Maintain compliance records and documentation in accordance with regulatory requirements.

Regulatory Filings & Examinations

  • Assist with preparation and review of regulatory filings, including Form ADV and other applicable filings.

  • Support SEC examinations, regulatory inquiries, and internal audits.

What will help you be successful in this role

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Law, Economics, or related field.

  • 5–8 years of compliance experience within an investment adviser, asset manager, private fund manager, ETF sponsor, or similar financial institution.

  • Direct experience supporting private equity funds, private debt/private credit funds, and/or ETF products.

  • Strong knowledge of the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 and SEC regulatory requirements.

  • Experience conducting compliance monitoring, testing, and regulatory reviews.

  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting registered investment products, both traditional and semi-liquid.

  • Familiarity with Form ADV, SEC examinations, and compliance surveillance tools.

  • Knowledge of marketing rule requirements and private fund regulations.

  • Professional certifications such as CFA, CPA, JD, IACCP, or equivalent.

  • Experience working with institutional investors, fund distribution, and capital raising activities.

title: Tech Lead - Digital Assets
description:
Marketnode is Asia-Pacific’s digital market infrastructure (DMI) operator, backed by Euroclear, HSBC, SGX Group and Temasek.
Our unique combination of data, networks and access capabilities enables financial institutions to turn data into operational intelligence, streamline transactions over shared networks and shorten time to market for funds, structured products and credit in traditional and digitally native formats. 

About the role

We are looking for an exceptional technology builder to take ownership of the technology underpinning our digital-assets and Real-World Asset tokenisation business. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to remain close to the technology while growing as an engineering leader. You will spend approximately half your time designing, building and reviewing solutions, demonstrating what excellent engineering looks like and leading the team by example. The remainder of your time will be focused on technical strategy, architecture, team leadership, product collaboration and delivery.
 
You will take ownership of an existing platform spanning RWA tokenisation, smart contracts, blockchain networks, Fireblocks integrations and the off-chain systems required to support real-world financial products. You will jointly shape the product and technology roadmap with Product and work closely with the Senior Delivery Manager to turn that roadmap into reliable delivery.
The role requires someone who can connect Web3 technology with the realities of Web2 systems, regulated financial services and real-world operations. Tokenised products still depend on off-chain data, approvals, controls, legal events, reconciliations and operational processes. You will ensure these components work together as a secure, coherent and scalable platform.
 

Key responsibilities

Hands-on technical leadership

  • Remain actively involved in architecture, software development, smart-contract development and code review.
  • Demonstrate high engineering standards through your own designs, code, testing and documentation.
  • Work alongside engineers to solve complex technical problems and unblock delivery.
  • Establish practical standards for software design, code quality, testing, documentation and maintainability.
  • Make thoughtful build-versus-buy decisions and guide the selection of technologies, frameworks and integration patterns.
  • Stay current with developments in blockchain, digital assets, AI-assisted engineering and financial technology.
  • Create a culture in which technical leaders remain close enough to the work to make informed decisions.

Platform and architecture ownership

  • Take end-to-end technical ownership of the existing digital-assets and RWA tokenisation platform.
  • Define and evolve the target architecture in support of the business and product strategy.
  • Ensure the platform is secure, scalable, resilient, observable and maintainable.
  • Own the technical integration of blockchain networks, smart contracts, custody infrastructure, product applications and off-chain services.
  • Establish appropriate architectural principles and review processes without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Maintain a clear view of technical debt and ensure it is considered alongside new product development.
  • Have the authority to approve technical designs and reject approaches that do not meet agreed security, quality or architectural standards.

Multi-chain and smart-contract development

  • Lead the design and development of blockchain solutions across EVM-compatible networks, Stellar and Solana.
  • Maintain deep expertise in at least one of these ecosystems and sufficient knowledge to lead engineering decisions across all three.
  • Lead smart-contract development using Solidity and the relevant languages and frameworks for Stellar and Solana.
  • Guide the use and implementation of token standards suitable for regulated assets, including permissioning, identity controls and transfer restrictions.
  • Define standards for smart-contract design, testing, deployment, upgrades and monitoring.
  • Coordinate independent smart-contract reviews and audits where required.
  • Ensure on-chain logic is appropriately separated from off-chain business processes and controls.

RWA tokenisation lifecycle

  • Own the technical capabilities supporting the full lifecycle of tokenised real-world assets.
  • Support issuance, investor eligibility, identity and allowlisting, transfer controls, corporate actions, distributions, redemptions, reconciliation and secondary transfers.
  • Design solutions that accurately connect on-chain assets with their underlying legal and financial records.
  • Account for off-chain events such as approvals, document execution, payment confirmation, asset servicing and exception handling.
  • Ensure that on-chain and off-chain states remain consistent, traceable and auditable.
  • Work with Product, Operations, Legal and Compliance to translate product and regulatory requirements into robust technical solutions.

Custody

  • Ensure transaction workflows, wallet interactions, signing requests and application integrations are secure and reliable.
  • Understand how custody and transaction controls affect application architecture and the end-to-end user journey.
  • Work with internal security, operations and infrastructure specialists on wallet governance, transaction controls and production support.
  • Manage the technical relationship with Fireblocks and other relevant technology providers when required.

Product and roadmap partnership

  • Jointly own the product and technology roadmap with the Product team.
  • Bring technical opportunities, constraints, risks and dependencies into product planning.
  • Help Product assess feasibility, sequencing and trade-offs before delivery commitments are made.
  • Translate business and customer needs into coherent technical capabilities.
  • Challenge requirements constructively when a simpler, safer or more scalable solution is available.
  • Ensure foundational platform work, security improvements and technical debt receive appropriate roadmap consideration.
  • Support future conversations with clients, banks, custodians, partners and other external stakeholders by communicating technical ideas clearly.

Delivery partnership

  • Work closely with the Senior Delivery Manager, who will lead portfolio governance, dependency tracking and delivery reporting.
  • Own technical execution, engineering quality and the credibility of technical estimates.
  • Ensure the delivery plan reflects architectural dependencies, security requirements and realistic engineering capacity.
  • Identify technical risks and blockers early and provide clear mitigation or recovery plans.
  • Maintain transparency on progress, quality, dependencies and technical debt.
  • Support predictable releases without compromising platform security or engineering standards.

Team leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop an engineering team of approximately 10 people across Singapore and India.
  • Build an engaged, collaborative and high-performing distributed team.
  • Set clear expectations for engineering behaviour, ownership, quality and delivery.
  • Provide regular feedback, coaching and career-development support.
  • Create an environment in which engineers can challenge ideas, learn from mistakes and continuously improve.
  • Raise the capability of the team through mentoring, pairing, design reviews and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in recruitment and use professional networks to help attract strong digital-asset and engineering talent.
  • Assess skills gaps and build a practical plan for developing or hiring the capabilities the business needs.

Security and operational quality

  • Embed secure engineering practices throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Ensure appropriate threat modelling, code review, automated testing, vulnerability management and release controls are followed.
  • Work with security specialists to coordinate smart-contract audits, penetration testing and remediation.
  • Ensure systems handling transactions, keys, wallet requests and sensitive data receive an appropriate level of scrutiny.
  • Contribute technical leadership during incidents and post-incident reviews.
  • Ensure technical decisions and controls can withstand appropriate client, audit and regulatory scrutiny.

AI-enabled engineering

  • Increase product and engineering throughput through the effective use of AI-assisted development tools.
  • Lead by example in using AI for software development, testing, code review, documentation, analysis and troubleshooting.
  • Help the team distinguish valuable AI-enabled practices from low-quality or unsafe shortcuts.
  • Establish appropriate controls for confidential information, intellectual property, security and generated code.
  • Measure whether AI tools are improving throughput, quality and developer effectiveness.
  • Build an engineering culture that treats AI capability as an important part of modern software development.

Experience and qualifications

  • At least eight years of professional software engineering and technology-delivery experience.
  • At least four years of experience leading teams or major technical initiatives in digital assets, blockchain or tokenisation.
  • Demonstrated experience taking ownership of a complex existing platform.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering and architecture capabilities.
  • Production experience designing and delivering blockchain applications across multiple networks.
  • Strong knowledge of EVM-based development, Stellar and Solana, with deep expertise in at least one ecosystem.
  • Hands-on smart-contract development experience, including Solidity.
  • Experience with regulated-token or permissioned-token patterns, such as identity controls, allowlisting and transfer restrictions.
  • Practical experience integrating applications through Fireblocks APIs and SDKs.
  • Experience connecting on-chain applications with Web2 platforms, databases, APIs and operational workflows.
  • Experience with the complete RWA or digital-asset lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated success managing distributed engineering teams.
  • Experience working closely with Product to shape and deliver a shared roadmap.
  • Working knowledge of Azure, DevOps, CI/CD, observability and production operations.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a closely related discipline.

Skills and attributes

  • An exceptional builder who wants to develop further as a technology and people leader.
  • Able to lead through technical credibility and personal example.
  • Strong architecture and systems-thinking capabilities.
  • Comfortable moving between code, architecture, product strategy and team leadership.
  • Able to explain complex technical ideas to product leaders, executives, clients and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Pragmatic and commercially aware, with an appreciation of delivery constraints.
  • Willing to challenge decisions constructively and take accountability for technical outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of security and risk in financial and digital-asset systems.
  • Effective at leading distributed, cross-cultural teams.
  • Curious, adaptable and committed to continuous learning.
  • Able to attract, assess and develop excellent technical talent.

Desirable experience

  • Experience in banking, capital markets, fintech or another regulated financial-services environment.
  • Familiarity with MAS expectations and institutional digital-asset controls.
  • Experience working with custodians, banks, issuers, fund managers or financial-market infrastructure providers.
  • Experience supporting institutional-grade token issuance and servicing.
  • Knowledge of securities, funds, bonds or other commonly tokenised asset classes.
  • Experience contributing to client, partner, auditor or regulatory discussions.
  • An established professional network within digital assets, blockchain or financial technology.

What this role offers

This is an opportunity for an exceptional technology builder to take ownership of an institutional digital-assets platform and grow into a broader technology leadership position.
You will remain hands-on, lead a distributed engineering team and shape products spanning RWA tokenisation, smart contracts, multiple blockchain ecosystems and the off-chain infrastructure needed to make digital assets work in the real world.

Job description

The Role

You'll manage the cross-functional operations that keep Altitude moving.

You'll drive people operations end to end, manage our board and investor relationships behind the scenes, and be the person who reads every vendor and partner agreement before it gets signed. You'll work daily with the founders and CBO.

This is not inbox triage with a title. The work sits close to the center of the company: people operations, board materials, partner contracts. It requires judgment, discretion, and the ability to run a dozen threads without dropping one.

What You'll Own

People Ops

  • Own onboarding and offboarding end to end: contracts, accounts, equipment delivery and inventory, first day through last
  • Process people paperwork across FTEs and EORs: employment contracts, salary increases, option grants, comp changes
  • Own and administer our HRIS and related people ops systems, and keep it the source of truth

Office & Culture

  • Manage physical office spaces and everything in them + paperwork tied to them
  • Own the culture layer: birthdays, gifts, swag, new-hire welcomes, team rituals that make a remote-friendly team feel like a team
  • Run team offsites end to end: venues, travel, logistics, agendas

Board & Investor Relations

  • Organize board meetings end to end: scheduling, materials, notes, follow-ups
  • Prepare board updates and own corporate admin
  • Handle investor document requests and run ongoing investor communications
  • Consult with outside counsel on corporate matters

Vendors & Partners

  • Review the business logic of every contract: understand the agreement, catch the red flags, and know what the partnership is actually worth to us
  • Manage document signing and keep internal stakeholders aligned through execution
  • Own recurring reporting requirements for our banking and infrastructure partners
  • Run day-to-day communications with vendors and partners

You Might Be Right For This If

  • You're the most organized person you know and it's not close
  • You handle sensitive information (comp, cap table, board materials) with total discretion
  • You're comfortable in the room with lawyers, investors, and executives
  • You're proactive: you fix things before anyone asks and flag risks before they land
  • You can context-switch between an option grant, a board deck, and a vendor renewal without dropping any of them
  • You use AI to automate the repetitive work so your time goes to what actually needs judgment
  • You're low-ego and high-ownership: no task is beneath you, no system is beyond you
  • You move fast, make decisions, and don't need approval loops to ship

Requirements

  • 3+ years in operations, corporate admin, or legal ops at a high-growth startup
  • Track record of running high-stakes processes with zero drops: board cycles, contract workflows, people paperwork
  • Exceptional organization and follow-through. This is non-negotiable.
  • Enough contract fluency to read an agreement and flag what matters commercially, not just legally. You're not a lawyer, and you know when to call one.
  • AI-native: your first instinct is to automate, not to grind
  • Comfortable operating across time zones with a global team

Why This Might Be Interesting

Most ops roles keep you far from the decisions. This one puts you next to them. You'll see the board materials, the cap table, the partner agreements, and the comp decisions, and you'll be trusted to support all of it.

Altitude is early enough that the internal machinery doesn't exist yet. You'll build it, and it will scale with the company. Very few roles offer this much trust and surface area this early.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI tools for automation.

Responsibilities

  • Own onboarding and offboarding end to end.
  • Process people paperwork across FTEs and EORs.
  • Administer HRIS and related people ops systems.
  • Manage physical office spaces and related paperwork.
  • Own the culture layer and team rituals.
  • Organize board meetings and prepare materials.
  • Handle investor document requests and communications.
  • Review vendor contracts and manage document signing.

Required skills

  • Operations(must have)

    Manage cross-functional operations, ensuring smooth execution of people operations, board materials, and partner contracts.

  • Project Management(must have)

    Review and understand vendor and partner agreements, identifying key commercial aspects and potential risks.

  • Human Resources(must have)

    Administer HRIS and related systems, ensuring they serve as the source of truth for people operations.

  • AI(nice to have)

    Utilize AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing focus on high-judgment work.
